submission.comment: Found an RSI mean-reversion strategy (period=14, lower=20, upper=87) with annualized Sharpe ratio of 1.012, annual return of 15.5%, annual volatility of 15.3%, and max drawdown of 14.4%. The strategy trades only 7.1% of the time with low turnover (4.75% daily), making it a high Sharpe, low-risk strategy. Tested 413 strategy combinations across momentum, MA crossover, breakout, mean reversion, and RSI families.
